rows.claim: slugify now decomposes the text (NFKD) and drops combining accent marks, so "Crème brûlée à la carte" becomes "creme-brulee-a-la-carte".
rows.evidence: The write_file for textutil/slug.py (T0B13) used unicodedata.normalize("NFKD") and an ascii-ignore encode, and the final pytest run (T0B20) shows 9 passed, including test_accents asserting slugify("Crème brûlée à la carte") == "creme-brulee-a-la-carte".
